offering_description.value: Owns and operates movie theatre circuits and hotels and resorts, mainly in the US Midwest. Sells movie tickets, food and beverages to moviegoers, and lodging, dining and event space to travelers and groups. Also manages hotels for third-party owners.

primary_products.value: movie tickets; concession food and beverages

primary_services.value: movie theatre exhibition; hotel lodging; hotel and resort management; restaurant and event hosting

customer_segment.value: B2C: moviegoers and leisure and business hotel guests; B2B: group events, corporate travel, hotel owners using management services, advertisers

end_markets.value: movie entertainment; hospitality and lodging; leisure travel

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: theatre admission tickets and concession purchases; service fees: hotel room rentals, food and beverage, and event services; commissions or management fees: fees for managing third-party owned hotels; advertising: on-screen and in-theatre advertising
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; service fees; commissions or management fees; advertising

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs movie theatres and hotels, licensing films from studios and selling to consumers; service provider: manages hotels and resorts for third-party owners

geography_served.value: US regional: Theatres and hotels mainly in Wisconsin, Illinois, Iowa, Minnesota, Ohio and other Midwest states

specialization.value: related lines: movie theatres and hotels and resorts, both hospitality and entertainment venues

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-owned theatres, hotels and restaurants; online: website and app ticketing and hotel bookings; third-party retail: online travel agencies and ticketing platforms

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Liquor licensing, food safety, building and accessibility rules, labor and consumer protection laws
